relations.subject: index-type:index-span
relations.evidence: Once the index path is chosen, the query engine requests the Index Service to perform a scan. This scan is defined by a specific range of values that the query engine needs to retrieve. These ranges are represented as spans in the query plan.

notable_absence.finding: Purely a query-plan mechanics reference (span/inclusion semantics across ~30 predicate-translation examples) with no access-control content whatsoever - the third of four indexes/ pages in this batch confirming the low-RBAC-content hypothesis. Also notable: this page has no 'Related Links'/'See Also' section at all, unlike covering-indexes.md and groupby-aggregate-performance.md, even though both of those pages link back to this one via '#query-execution-details' - a one-directional cross-reference gap.
